description: Starkregensimulation Wuppertal SRI 10 (Version 2.1 | 10/2022) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by daten.wuppertal.de. The data set comprises the result data of the simulation of a synthetic heavy rain event with the heavy rain index 10 (SRI 10), carried out in October 2022 by Dr. Pecher AG (Erkrath) on behalf of the city of Wuppertal, commissioned by Wuppertaler Stadtwerke WSW Energie und Wasser AG. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Heavy rain simulation Wuppertal SRI 10 (version 2.1 | 10/2022)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Klimawandel, Wuppertal, Wuppertaler Stadtwerke, GDI-W, Regenwasserabfluss, Blockregen. The listing shows 4 download or service links in TIFF, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
